fullTextEN: Hello!
I am from Heilongjiang, China,
Now I live in Guangzhou.

fullTextZH: 因为我是中国黑龙江人，
fullTextEN: Because I am from Heilongjiang, China,

fullTextZH: 所以我想给你介绍一下我的家乡黑龙江。
fullTextEN: So I want to introduce my hometown Heilongjiang to you.
Do you know Heilongjiang?
Have you heard of Heilongjiang?
Have you been to Heilongjiang?

fullTextZH: 黑龙江是中国的一个省，
fullTextEN: Heilongjiang is a province in China,
in the northeast direction of China,

fullTextZH: 所以很多人也叫我们东北人。
fullTextEN: so many people also call us Northeasterners.
So, I am a Heilongjiang person,

fullTextZH: 你也可以说我是东北人。
fullTextEN: You can also say I am a Northeasterner.
As a Northeasterner,
I want to recommend you to visit the Northeast.
Why?

fullTextZH: 因为东北有很多元的文化，
fullTextEN: Because the Northeast has a diverse culture,

fullTextZH: 就是各种各样不同的文化。
fullTextEN: which means various different cultures.
Do you know?
China has a total of 56 ethnic groups,
Except for the Han nationality,

fullTextZH: 其他55个民族是少数民族。
fullTextEN: The other 55 ethnic groups are minorities.
I am Han Chinese,

fullTextZH: 但是黑龙江有很多少数民族。
fullTextEN: But Heilongjiang has many ethnic minorities.
Let's first look at the first picture.

fullTextZH: 如果你常常看中国古装电视剧，
fullTextEN: If you often watch Chinese costume dramas,

fullTextZH: 那你会常常看到很多这样的衣服。
fullTextEN: Then you will often see many clothes like this.
They are the Manchu people.

fullTextZH: 你知道中国以前不是中国，
fullTextEN: You know China was not China before,
Was it the Qing Dynasty?

fullTextZH: 清朝是中国最后的朝代。
fullTextEN: The Qing Dynasty was China's last dynasty.
The Manchu were the rulers of the Qing Dynasty.

fullTextZH: 现在我们来看第二张图。
fullTextEN: Now let's look at the second picture.
What is this?
This is the Man-Han Feast.
Man-Han refers to the Manchu and Han people,

fullTextZH: 满汉全席就是满族和汉族一起聚会吃饭时吃的宴席。
fullTextEN: The Man-Han Feast is a banquet eaten when the Manchu and Han people gather to eat.
It means eating many, many dishes,

fullTextZH: 这些菜包含了满族和汉族的所有菜系，
fullTextEN: These dishes include all the cuisines of the Manchu and Han people,
So it's called the Man-Han Feast.
Have you heard of the Manchu-Han Imperial Feast?
I've only heard of it,
haven't seen it,
haven't eaten it.

fullTextZH: 满汉全席这个词在中国的意思就是很多很多菜的意思。
fullTextEN: In China, the term 'Manchu-Han Imperial Feast' means a lot of dishes.
So how many dishes are there?
Legend has it that during the Qing Dynasty,
the Manchu-Han Imperial Feast
had a total of 108 dishes,
and it took 3 days to finish 108 dishes.
Did you know?

fullTextZH: 在中文中有一些词不是普通话，
fullTextEN: In Chinese, some words are not Mandarin,
but the language of the Manchu people—Manchu.
For example, the hutongs in Harbin,
Oh, right,

fullTextZH: 还有一个零食叫沙琪玛，
fullTextEN: there's also a snack called Sachima,
which is a traditional Manchu food,

fullTextZH: 是我们小时候常常吃的零食。
fullTextEN: and it's a snack we often ate as children.
I really like eating it,
look,

fullTextZH: 你知道他们是中国的哪个少数民族吗？
fullTextEN: Do you know which minority group in China they belong to?

fullTextZH: 他们看起来像韩国人，对不对？
fullTextEN: They look like Koreans, don't they?
Yes,

fullTextZH: 他们就是中国的朝鲜族，
fullTextEN: They are the Korean ethnic group in China,
which means they are Koreans in China.
What are the characteristics of the Korean ethnic group?

fullTextZH: 第一个特点是他们的衣服，
fullTextEN: The first characteristic is their clothing,

fullTextZH: 你看，他们的衣服上窄下宽，对吗？
fullTextEN: Look, their clothes are narrow at the top and wide at the bottom, right?
Narrow at the top and wide at the bottom,

fullTextZH: 跟满族的衣服很不一样。
fullTextEN: very different from Manchu clothing.

fullTextZH: 第二个特点是他们擅长唱歌跳舞，
fullTextEN: The second characteristic is they are good at singing and dancing,
They are very good at singing and dancing.
Yes,
This is their traditional dance.

fullTextZH: 朝鲜族的美食也很丰富，
fullTextEN: The Korean ethnic group's cuisine is also very rich,
with many, many kinds,
all kinds.
For example, cold noodles,
I really like cold noodles,
because they are cold noodles,
So it is cold,
It is not hot.
There are ice cubes in its noodle soup,

fullTextZH: 因为有冰块，所以它是冷的。
fullTextEN: Because there are ice cubes, it is cold.
It tastes sweet and sour,
Very refreshing,
Very suitable for eating in summer.

fullTextZH: 还有，朝鲜族人很喜欢泡菜。
fullTextEN: Also, Korean people really like kimchi.

fullTextZH: 朝鲜族的美食大多是甜辣和咸辣的口味。
fullTextEN: Most Korean cuisine is sweet and spicy or salty and spicy.
As for me,
Because I live in Heilongjiang,
There are many Koreans there,

fullTextZH: 所以我常常吃朝鲜族美食。
fullTextEN: So I often eat Korean cuisine.
I really like Korean cuisine,
I don't know if you like it.

fullTextZH: 现在我们来看第三张图，
fullTextEN: Now let's look at the third picture,
What ethnicity is this?
This is Mongolian.
What are the characteristics of Mongolians?

fullTextZH: 蒙古族他们从小到大都生活在草原上，
fullTextEN: Mongolians live on the grasslands from childhood to adulthood,
A place with a lot of grass,
Grassland.
So they are good at horseback riding,
Good at archery.

fullTextZH: 蒙古族最有特色的是他们的房子，
fullTextEN: The most distinctive feature of the Mongolian people is their houses,

fullTextZH: 他们的房子下面是圆圆的，
fullTextEN: Their houses are round at the bottom,
And pointed at the top,
Like a mushroom.
Only on the grassland,

fullTextZH: 才可以看到这样的蒙古包。
fullTextEN: Can you see such yurts.

fullTextZH: 为什么他们不住在普通的房子里呢？
fullTextEN: Why don't they live in regular houses?
Because they are nomadic people,
They need to go to places with grass,

fullTextZH: 不能只固定在一个地方住。
fullTextEN: They can't just stay in one fixed place.

fullTextZH: 你看，这个东西叫鱼皮画，
fullTextEN: Look, this thing is called fish skin painting,

fullTextZH: 这个画是用鱼的皮做成的。
fullTextEN: This painting is made from fish skin.

fullTextZH: 做这个画的民族是一个少数民族，
fullTextEN: The people who make this painting are a minority group,
Called the Hezhe people.

fullTextZH: 他们生活在松花江旁边，
fullTextEN: They live by the Songhua River,

fullTextZH: 主要靠打鱼来维持生活。
fullTextEN: Mainly rely on fishing to sustain their lives.

fullTextZH: 他们也是中国人口最少的少数民族之一。
fullTextEN: They are also one of the smallest ethnic minorities in China by population.

fullTextZH: 黑龙江除了有不同的少数民族文化，
fullTextEN: In addition to having different ethnic minority cultures, Heilongjiang
also has a lot of foreign cultures.

fullTextZH: 因为黑龙江离俄罗斯很近，
fullTextEN: Because Heilongjiang is very close to Russia,
so in Heilongjiang,

fullTextZH: 可以买到各种各样的俄罗斯东西，
fullTextEN: you can buy all kinds of Russian things,

fullTextZH: 还可以看到俄罗斯的建筑。
fullTextEN: and you can also see Russian architecture.

fullTextZH: 说了这么多关于黑龙江的文化，
fullTextEN: Having talked so much about the culture of Heilongjiang,
which one are you more interested in?
Do you want to visit Heilongjiang?
What do you want to see in Heilongjiang?
Welcome!
Then we'll see you next time,
Goodbye!
